name: Csorvás (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over white, charged at the centre with the town arms of Csorvás (a blue and green shield with ears of grain, a hand and a flower) above the name CSORVÁS in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
